question: Does the website signal engine's monthly Buy/Hold/Sell call beat buying and holding the market, measured on a TOTAL-RETURN instrument with non-overlapping compounding?
scope: 2020-01-01..2025-06-01 eval dates (66 monthly signals); realised price span 2019-12-31..2025-09-02 because each signal carries a 3-month forward window. SPY adjusted close. Costs: 32.0 bps per round trip.
supersedes: backend/BACKTEST_RESULTS.md as generated 2026-03-30 (commit 074e229), which published +250.9% strategy vs +740.0% buy-and-hold. That run used ^GSPC (price index, no dividends) AND compounded all 66 overlapping 3-month windows as if sequential (~3.12x log inflation). Compounding fixed 2026-04-15 in 726c7bf; the document was never regenerated. Benchmark fixed 2026-09-04 (roadmap B1).

provenance.construction: yfinance auto_adjust=True Close (dividend- and split-adjusted) -> total return of a tradeable fund
provenance.retired: ^GSPC price index, used as 'the market' until 2026-09-04 (roadmap B1)

compounding.why: 3-month forward windows sampled monthly overlap; compounding all of them counts each month ~3x and inflates the log return ~3.12x (the 2026-03-30 defect, fixed in 726c7bf)

cross_check.independent_re_derivation: learner.benchmark.pinned_market_total_return on the hash-gated Fama-French daily vintage gives the CRSP value-weighted market total return 2020-01-02..2025-05-30 = +96.67% plain buy-and-hold, and +112.2% over the every-3rd quarterly chain's own span. SPY's +114.79% here is the same object measured on a tradeable fund -- the two rulers agree to ~2.6pp.
cross_check.the_void_number_reproduced: compounding all 66 overlapping windows on the pinned market gives +949.0%; the ratio of log returns all-66 / every-3rd is 3.123.

verdict: The signal engine's timing LOSES to holding, and by a wider relative margin than the void figures suggested: +28.3% net vs +114.79% buy-and-hold (ratio 0.247, versus 0.339 under the void numbers). The DIRECTION of NEGATIVE_RESULTS section 1 is therefore CONFIRMED on a correct ruler; its magnitudes are replaced.
caveat: The signal distribution itself changed (buy 43->34, hold 16->27, sell 7->5) because the signal engine reads the same price series it is scored on, and that series changed from ^GSPC to SPY adjusted. This is not a like-for-like re-scoring of the same 66 calls; it is the engine re-run on a total-return instrument. Both runs are on ONE instrument, so this is a market-timing result and says nothing about stock selection.
not_a_claim: PRODUCT_EXPERIMENT licence: no significance gate, no multiplicity control, single window, n=22 independent quarters. A negative of this size does not need them; a positive would.
